remarks: Welcome to Adams Mill River House.This beautifully renovated condo offers the convenience of 1 level living, with 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms and multiple walk-in closets. Immaculate kitchen with newer stainless steel appliances (2024). Updated HVAC (2024) and hot water heater (2023), and in-unit washer & dryer. Largest, rear facing, private balcony in the building. Fully loaded fitness center, private garden area with a gazebo, picnic tables and grills for residents to enjoy year round. Pet friendly, elevator building with a gated private parking garage, plenty of guest parking, and freshly painted common areas. Just steps to shopping, restaurants, schools, beaches, golf courses and hospitals. Nearby Mill River Park features food trucks, festivals, concerts, outdoor movies, an ice-skating rink, walking trails, carousel & so much more. Also minutes to the Metro North commuter train and Amtrak, with easy access to both I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.
